title: "Toronto Permits Map"
---

```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)

library(osmdata)
library(osmextract)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(units)
library(lwgeom)
library(scales)

# Used below to shrink the dissemination-block polygons that get embedded in
# the rendered page. Installed once if missing.
if (!requireNamespace("rmapshaper", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("rmapshaper")
library(rmapshaper)
```


```{r echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
source("load_data.R")
```


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Performance prep: the rendered .qmd embeds every polygon/point as GeoJSON
# directly in the page's HTML, so on a static host (GitHub Pages) the file
# size and vertex/feature count *are* the load time. Nothing below drops a
# single building permit or a single dissemination block -- it only trims
# columns the map never uses and reduces vertex density on the polygons.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------

# 1) Keep only the columns the map actually reads. `toronto_FSA` and
#    `toronto_permits_2021` carry many unused columns (raw permit fields,
#    census vectors, etc.) that otherwise get serialized into the widget's
#    embedded GeoJSON for every single row.
toronto_FSA_map <- toronto_FSA |>
  select(DBUID, Denisty)

toronto_permits_2021_map <- toronto_permits_2021 |>
  select(change, pop_up)

# 2) Simplify the dissemination-block boundaries. These blocks are tiny
#    (city-block sized) and carry far more coordinate precision than is
#    visible at any zoom level a website visitor uses. `keep_shapes = TRUE`
#    guarantees every polygon survives (none are dropped) -- only the
#    number of vertices per polygon shrinks, and shared borders between
#    neighbouring blocks are preserved so there are no gaps/slivers.
toronto_FSA_map <- ms_simplify(
  toronto_FSA_map,
  keep = 0.1,
  keep_shapes = TRUE
)

pal_dens <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#F3EFFD", "#D9CFFB", "#BAABF5", "#9885ED", "#7660E0", "#5A3EC8", "#4228A8", "#2E1880", "#1E0E60", "#100740"),
  domain = toronto_FSA_map$Denisty
)

permit_colour <- colorFactor(palette = c("orange", "#004D2C"),
                          domain = toronto_permits$change)

leaflet(toronto_FSA_map, options = leafletOptions(
    preferCanvas = TRUE,
    # Safari's WebKit engine handles the CSS-transform zoom/pan animation
    # much worse than Chrome/Firefox once thousands of canvas features are
    # on screen -- it tends to stutter or momentarily lock up mid-animation.
    # Turning the animation off makes zoom/pan an instant redraw instead,
    # which is a bit less smooth-looking but far more reliable in Safari.
    zoomAnimation = FALSE,
    markerZoomAnimation = FALSE,
    fadeAnimation = FALSE
  )) |>
addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron",
                  options = providerTileOptions(updateWhenZooming = FALSE, updateWhenIdle = TRUE)) |>
    addFullscreenControl() |>
  addMapPane("top_layer_pane", zIndex = 450) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_dens(Denisty),
    color = "black",
    weight = 0.4,
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    # label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
     popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
    group = "Building Permits (2020-2021)"
  )|>
    addCircleMarkers(
      data = toronto_permits_2021_map,
      radius = 2,
    color = ~permit_colour(change),
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.2,
    group = "Building Permits (2020-2021)",
    popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
    options = pathOptions(
       popup_base = toronto_permits_2021_map$pop_up

    )
  ) |>
  #
  # addPolygons(
  #   fillColor = ~pal_dens(Denisty),
  #   color = "black",
  #   weight = 1,
  #   fillOpacity = 0.6,
  #   # label = ~paste(`Canadidate and Party`),
  #    popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
  #   group = "Building Permits (all time)"
  # )|> 
  #   addCircleMarkers(
  #     data = toronto_permits_2021,
  #     radius = 2,
  #   color = ~permit_colour(change),
  #   weight = 1,
  #   fillOpacity = 0.2,
  #   group = "Building Permits (all time)",
  #   popupOptions = popupOptions(closeOnClick = FALSE),
  #   options = pathOptions(
  #      popup_base = toronto_permits$pop_up
  # 
  #   )
  # ) |> 
addLayersControl(
     baseGroups = c( "Building Permits (2020-2021)", "Building Permits (all time)"),
    options = layersControlOptions(autoZIndex = TRUE,
                                   collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>% 
   hideGroup(c(
   "Building Permits (all time)", "Demographics", "Transit Connectivity"
  )) %>%
  onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var map = this;

      function updatePopups(mode) {
        map.eachLayer(function(layer) {
          if (layer.options && layer.options.popup_base) {
            var html;
            if (mode === 'permit') {
              html = layer.options.popup_base;
            } else if (mode === 'demo') {
              html = layer.options.popup_demo;
            } else if (mode === 'bus') {
              html = layer.options.pop_up_routes;
            } else if (mode === 'connect') {
              html = layer.options.popup_transit;
            } else {
              html = layer.options.popup_base;
            }
            layer.bindPopup(html, { closeOnClick: false });
          }
        });
      }

      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        if (e.name === 'Permit Data ') {
          updatePopups('permit');
        }
        if (e.name === 'Demographics') {
          updatePopups('demo');
        }
        if (e.name === 'Bus Stops') {
          updatePopups('bus');
        } 
        if (e.name === 'Transit Connectivity') {
          updatePopups('connect');
        }
      } 
      );

      map.on('overlayremove', function(e) {
        updatePopups('base');
      });

      updatePopups('base');
    }
  ")

```
